# HLS.js

`hls.min.js` is the unmodified full distribution from npm `hls.js@1.6.16`,
licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `hls.LICENSE`). The full build is required for
MediaMTX manifests containing separate audio playlists; the light build omits
alternate-audio support.

Source: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/tree/v1.6.16
